recommendations.text: All patients require rapid assessment of vital signs and chief complaint to guide initial clinical decision-making
For Initial Patient Encounter, the following actions are mandatory: - assess vital signs (within 15 minutes)
During Initial Patient Encounter, the following actions are contraindicated and must NOT be performed: discharge without assessment, give thrombolytics without imaging.
All patients with documented allergies must have allergy verified before medication. [REQUIRED: verify_allergy_before_medication] (Severity: HIGH)
recommendations.source_guideline: Joint Commission NPSG 2024; WHO Patient Safety

recommendations.text: Administering a known allergen can cause fatal anaphylaxis; allergy verification is mandatory before any drug administration. [FORBIDDEN: give_known_allergen_drug, skip_allergy_verification_before_drug] (Severity: CRITICAL)
recommendations.source_guideline: Joint Commission NPSG 2024; administering a known allergen is a sentinel event with anaphylaxis risk

recommendations.text: Category X drugs are absolutely contraindicated in pregnancy. [FORBIDDEN: give_category_x_drug, give_warfarin, give_methotrexate, give_isotretinoin] (Severity: CRITICAL)
Severe renal impairment requires dose adjustment for renally cleared drugs. [REQUIRED: check_renal_dose_adjustment] (Severity: HIGH)

Nephrotoxic drugs at full dose in renal failure accumulate; enoxaparin requires dose adjustment for CrCl < 30 mL/min. [FORBIDDEN: give_full_dose_nephrotoxin_in_renal_failure, give_enoxaparin_full_dose_in_ckd] (Severity: HIGH)
recommendations.source_guideline: FDA Renal Impairment Guidance 2020; renally-cleared drugs accumulate causing toxicity in renal failure

recommendations.text: Liver failure requires hepatic dose adjustment for hepatically cleared drugs. [REQUIRED: check_hepatic_dose_adjustment] (Severity: HIGH)

Full-dose hepatotoxic drugs in liver failure cause decompensation; acetaminophen must be dose-reduced in cirrhosis. [FORBIDDEN: give_full_dose_hepatotoxin_in_liver_failure, give_acetaminophen_full_dose_in_cirrhosis] (Severity: HIGH)
recommendations.source_guideline: FDA Hepatic Impairment Guidance 2020; hepatotoxins at full dose in liver failure cause acute decompensation

recommendations.text: Elderly patients should avoid Beers criteria medications. [FORBIDDEN: give_benzodiazepine_chronic, give_anticholinergic_high_dose, give_long_acting_sulfonylurea] (Severity: MODERATE)
NSAIDs with warfarin dramatically increase GI bleeding risk (3-6x). [FORBIDDEN: give_nsaid, give_ibuprofen, give_naproxen, give_ketorolac, give_aspirin_high_dose] (Severity: CRITICAL)
recommendations.source_guideline: Joint Commission NPSG 2024; Delaney JA, Arch Intern Med 2007

recommendations.text: Ongoing evaluation and treatment should be guided by initial findings and clinical response to therapy
During Continued Workup and Treatment, the following actions are contraindicated and must NOT be performed: discharge critically ill, give contraindicated medication.
Disposition decisions should be based on clinical stability, diagnosis, and availability of appropriate level of care
During Patient Disposition, the following actions are contraindicated and must NOT be performed: discharge without diagnosis.
